dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency diffuse grey patches visible across the mid and posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between pigmented grey areas and the lighter baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint longitudinal linear markings visible along the posterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Narrow longitudinal depression/groove along the central dorsal axis in the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple superficial linear markings or rake marks visible along the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single dark circular blowhole aperture clearly visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
